scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace=@campaign/database && npm run build --workspace=@campaign/server && npm run build --workspace=@campaign/web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=@campaign/database && npm run build --workspace=@campaign/server && node --test apps/server/dist/config.test.js apps/server/dist/security.test.js apps/server/dist/session-paths.test.js apps/server/dist/whatsapp-manager.test.js apps/server/dist/queue-forecast.test.js apps/server/dist/schedule.test.js apps/server/dist/clock.test.js apps/server/dist/whatsapp.test.js apps/server/dist/pairing.test.js && npm run test:polling
scripts.test:polling: tsc --target ES2022 --module commonjs --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --outDir .tmp/polling-tests apps/web/src/lib/visible-polling.ts apps/web/src/lib/visible-polling.test.ts && node --test .tmp/polling-tests/visible-polling.test.js
scripts.test:integration: npm run build --workspace=@campaign/database && npm run build --workspace=@campaign/server && node --env-file=.env scripts/test-integration.cjs
scripts.setup:local: npm run db:check && npm run db:deploy && npm run db:generate && npm run build
